title: UNICEF Calls for Safe Play in Gaza on World Children's Day

sources.name: UNICEF State of Palestine
sources.title: Children claim their right to play in Gaza on World Children's Day

sources.name: UNICEF
sources.title: Convention on the Rights of the Child text

paragraphs.en: On November 20, 2026, UNICEF launched
paragraphs.zh: 2026年11月20日，聯合國兒童基金會發起了

paragraphs.en: a campaign called Back to Play! in Gaza.
paragraphs.zh: 名為「重返遊戲！」的活動，地點在加薩。

paragraphs.en: The announcement, published on World Children's Day,
paragraphs.zh: 這份在世界兒童日發布的公告，

paragraphs.en: focused on the lack of safe play spaces.
paragraphs.zh: 聚焦於安全遊戲空間不足的問題。

paragraphs.en: It presented play as part of children's recovery
paragraphs.zh: 公告將遊戲視為兒童復原的一部分，

paragraphs.en: and called for communities to make room for it.
paragraphs.zh: 並呼籲各個社區為遊戲創造空間。

paragraphs.en: UNICEF described serious gaps in everyday opportunities.
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國兒童基金會描述了日常活動機會上的嚴重缺口。

paragraphs.en: It said two thirds of families reported
paragraphs.zh: 該機構表示，三分之二的家庭回報，

paragraphs.en: no safe outdoor place for their children to play.
paragraphs.zh: 沒有安全的戶外場所可讓孩子遊戲。

paragraphs.en: Over three quarters of families with young children
paragraphs.zh: 有幼兒的家庭中，超過四分之三

paragraphs.en: reported having neither toys nor books.
paragraphs.zh: 回報既沒有玩具，也沒有書籍。

paragraphs.en: These figures were presented as families' reports,
paragraphs.zh: 這些數字是以家庭回報的形式提出，

paragraphs.en: not as a description of every individual household.
paragraphs.zh: 並非用來描述每一個個別家庭。

paragraphs.en: Children had already explained their priorities.
paragraphs.zh: 孩子們先前已說明自己的優先需求。

paragraphs.en: UNICEF said an earlier consultation involved
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國兒童基金會表示，先前的一次諮詢涵蓋了

paragraphs.en: more than 11,000 children in Gaza.
paragraphs.zh: 加薩超過11,000名兒童。

paragraphs.en: They asked for parks, sports fields,
paragraphs.zh: 他們希望有公園、運動場，

paragraphs.en: and places where they could play safely.
paragraphs.zh: 以及能安全遊戲的場所。

paragraphs.en: The new campaign therefore responds
paragraphs.zh: 因此，這項新活動回應了

paragraphs.en: to needs children themselves had expressed.
paragraphs.zh: 孩子們自己表達的需求。

paragraphs.en: Back to Play! builds on an existing programme
paragraphs.zh: 「重返遊戲！」以既有方案為基礎，

paragraphs.en: using guided activities in learning and community spaces.
paragraphs.zh: 該方案在學習與社區空間運用引導式活動。

paragraphs.en: Trained facilitators support these sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 受過訓練的帶領人員支援這些活動。

paragraphs.en: The campaign asks local groups to protect
paragraphs.zh: 這項活動請地方團體保障

paragraphs.en: children's time, space, and supervision for play.
paragraphs.zh: 兒童遊戲所需的時間、空間與照護。

paragraphs.en: A launch event alone cannot meet all those needs.
paragraphs.zh: 單靠一場啟動活動，無法滿足所有這些需求。

paragraphs.en: The wider World Children's Day campaign
paragraphs.zh: 更廣泛的世界兒童日活動

paragraphs.en: places children's voices at its centre.
paragraphs.zh: 以兒童的聲音為核心。

paragraphs.en: UNICEF encourages young people to describe
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國兒童基金會鼓勵孩子們描述

paragraphs.en: the future they want and the changes they need.
paragraphs.zh: 他們想要的未來，以及所需的改變。

paragraphs.en: Around the world, children take visible roles
paragraphs.zh: 在世界各地，兒童擔任受到關注的角色，

paragraphs.en: in media, public life, and other activities.
paragraphs.zh: 參與媒體、公共生活及其他活動。

paragraphs.en: The purpose is to bring their priorities
paragraphs.zh: 目的是讓他們的優先需求

paragraphs.en: into discussions usually led by adults.
paragraphs.zh: 進入通常由成人主導的討論。

paragraphs.en: UNICEF's global page also encourages parents and teachers
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國兒童基金會的全球活動頁面，也鼓勵家長與教師

paragraphs.en: to help children understand their rights,
paragraphs.zh: 協助孩子理解自己的權利，

paragraphs.en: linking public attention with conversations in homes and classrooms.
paragraphs.zh: 將公共關注與家庭、課堂中的對話連結起來。

paragraphs.en: There is a foundation for this participation
paragraphs.zh: 這樣的參與有其依據，

paragraphs.en: in the Convention on the Rights of the Child,
paragraphs.zh: 來自《兒童權利公約》，

paragraphs.en: adopted on November 20, 1989.
paragraphs.zh: 公約於1989年11月20日通過。

paragraphs.en: Article 12 recognizes children's right
paragraphs.zh: 第12條承認兒童

paragraphs.en: to express views about matters affecting them.
paragraphs.zh: 對影響自身的事項表達意見的權利。

paragraphs.en: It says those views should receive appropriate weight,
paragraphs.zh: 條文指出，這些意見應獲得適當重視，

paragraphs.en: considering the child's age and maturity.
paragraphs.zh: 並考量兒童的年齡及成熟度。

paragraphs.en: It concerns children capable of forming their own views.
paragraphs.zh: 條文關注的是有能力形成自己意見的兒童。

paragraphs.en: Listening is therefore connected to decisions,
paragraphs.zh: 因此，傾聽與決策相關，

paragraphs.en: not simply to giving children a speaking opportunity.
paragraphs.zh: 不僅僅是給孩子發言機會。

paragraphs.en: Article 31 recognizes children's rights
paragraphs.zh: 第31條承認兒童

paragraphs.en: to rest, leisure, play, and cultural activities.
paragraphs.zh: 享有休息、休閒、遊戲與文化活動的權利。

paragraphs.en: Other parts of the Convention address
paragraphs.zh: 公約其他部分則關注

paragraphs.en: health services and education.
paragraphs.zh: 健康服務與教育。

paragraphs.en: Reading these provisions together helps explain
paragraphs.zh: 綜合閱讀這些條文，有助於理解

paragraphs.en: why play appears alongside other needs
paragraphs.zh: 為何遊戲會與其他需求一同出現，

paragraphs.en: in discussions about children's futures.
paragraphs.zh: 成為討論兒童未來的一部分。

paragraphs.en: These rights cover several connected parts of childhood.
paragraphs.zh: 這些權利涵蓋童年中數個相互關聯的面向。

paragraphs.en: The Gaza announcement makes that discussion concrete.
paragraphs.zh: 加薩的這份公告，讓相關討論更具體。

paragraphs.en: A safe place, a trusted adult,
paragraphs.zh: 安全的場所、值得信任的成人，

paragraphs.en: and time with other children
paragraphs.zh: 以及與其他孩子相處的時間，

paragraphs.en: are practical concerns behind the campaign.
paragraphs.zh: 都是這項活動背後的實際考量。

paragraphs.en: Its launch describes an effort and an ambition;
paragraphs.zh: 活動的啟動說明了一項努力及願景；

paragraphs.en: it does not establish that every child
paragraphs.zh: 並不代表每個孩子

paragraphs.en: already has those opportunities.
paragraphs.zh: 都已經擁有這些機會。

paragraphs.en: The continuing challenge is turning attention
paragraphs.zh: 持續存在的挑戰，是把關注

paragraphs.en: into opportunities children can actually use.
paragraphs.zh: 轉化為兒童真正能使用的機會。

adopted.meaning: 通過、採納；文中指公約獲通過

an.meaning: 一個、一種；母音發音前的不定冠詞

are.meaning: 是；也可作被動語態的助動詞

around.meaning: 遍及；around the world指世界各地

as.meaning: 作為；presented as指以某種形式呈現

asked.meaning: 要求、表達希望；asked for指希望獲得某事物

back.meaning: 回到；Back to Play指重返遊戲

behind.meaning: 在…背後；文中指活動背後的實際考量

builds.meaning: 建立；builds on指以既有基礎進一步發展

by.meaning: 由、被；led by adults指由成人主導

called.meaning: 名為、稱作；called for也指呼籲

capable.meaning: 有能力的；capable of指有能力做某事

centre.meaning: 核心、中心；at its centre指以某事為核心

concerns.meaning: 關注、涉及（動詞）；也作名詞複數指考量或關切事項

convention.meaning: 公約；文中指《兒童權利公約》

day.meaning: 日、日子；World Children's Day指世界兒童日

does.meaning: 助動詞，用於第三人稱單數

facilitators.meaning: 活動帶領人員、引導者（複數）

for.meaning: 為了、對於；也表示某時段的

future.meaning: 未來；也可作形容詞表示未來的

futures.meaning: 未來（複數）；文中指不同兒童各自的未來

guided.meaning: 有引導的、由人員帶領的

had.meaning: 與過去分詞連用，構成過去完成式

has.meaning: 有；也可作現在完成式助動詞

household.meaning: 家戶、共同生活的一戶人家

in.meaning: 在某時間、領域或範圍中

involved.meaning: 涵蓋、涉及；文中指諮詢涵蓋的參與者

is.meaning: 是；也可作被動或進行式的助動詞

it.meaning: 它；依上下文指活動、公告或公約條文

its.meaning: 它的；依上下文指活動的

launch.meaning: 啟動、發起；launch event指啟動活動

make.meaning: 創造、使得；make room for指為…創造空間

more.meaning: 更多；more than指超過、不只是

needs.meaning: 需求（名詞複數）；也可作動詞表示需要

neither.meaning: 兩者都不；neither A nor B指既沒有A，也沒有B

nor.meaning: 也不；neither A nor B指既沒有A，也沒有B

of.meaning: …的；表示所屬、性質、內容等關係

on.meaning: 關於、就某事；也表示日期

places.meaning: 場所（名詞複數）；也作動詞指把某事置於某位置

presented.meaning: 發表、展示；presented as也指被呈現為

quarters.meaning: 四分之一（複數）；three quarters指四分之三

room.meaning: 空間；make room for指為…創造空間

that.meaning: 那個；也可引導內容子句或關係子句

the.meaning: 定冠詞，指特定或前文提過的事物

their.meaning: 他們的；文中指兒童或年輕人的

themselves.meaning: 他們自己；文中強調兒童親自表達需求

there.meaning: 那裡；亦與be連用表示存在

they.meaning: 他們；文中指兒童或年輕人

thirds.meaning: 三分之一（複數）；two thirds指三分之二

to.meaning: 到、向；也用於不定詞，接動詞原形

turning.meaning: 轉化；turn A into B指將A轉化為B

visible.meaning: 受到關注的、可被看見的

voices.meaning: 聲音、意見；文中指兒童的意見

weight.meaning: 重視程度；receive appropriate weight指獲得適當重視

were.meaning: be動詞的過去式；可與分詞連用構成被動語態或進行式

with.meaning: 與、透過；也表示具備某項條件

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the article?

choices.text: UNICEF announced that every child in Gaza now has a safe place to play.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。最後一段明確說明，活動啟動不代表每個孩子都已獲得相關機會。

choices.text: The campaign aims to replace education and health services with games.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七段將遊戲與教育、健康等需求一同討論，並非取代它們。

choices.text: A new UNICEF campaign connects safe play with recovery, children’s priorities, and their rights.
choices.explanation: 正確。文章從11月20日的活動出發，連結安全遊戲、兒童提出的需求及公約中的權利。

choices.text: The article mainly explains how to organize a private birthday party.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章報導國際兒童權利活動，並非生日派對指南。

quiz.explanation: 主旨需涵蓋新聞事件及其背景。第一段提出安全遊戲與復原，第三段說明兒童自己提出的需求，第六與第七段補上參與及遊戲權利的背景。

evidence.quote: It presented play as part of children's recovery and called for communities to make room for it.
The new campaign therefore responds to needs children themselves had expressed.

quiz.question: What is the most reasonable conclusion from the family reports described in the article?

choices.text: The reported shortages support the need for action, but do not mean every household has identical conditions.
choices.explanation: 正確。第二段呈現普遍缺口，也提醒這些數字不能直接描述每個家庭。

choices.text: Every household in Gaza has exactly the same number of books and toys.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。比例資料無法證明所有家庭的具體條件完全相同。

choices.text: The campaign has already removed every reported shortage.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。最後一段區分活動願景與已獲得機會，未宣告所有缺口已消失。

choices.text: The reports show that children never asked for play areas.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段指出，參與諮詢的孩子希望有公園、運動場及安全遊戲場所。

quiz.explanation: 比例與家庭回報能顯示需求，但不能推成每戶條件完全一致，也不能當作方案已成功的證據。第二段及最後一段共同界定了這些資訊的範圍。

evidence.quote: These figures were presented as families' reports, not as a description of every individual household.
Its launch describes an effort and an ambition; it does not establish that every child already has those opportunities.

quiz.question: How do the Convention and the discussion of children’s voices relate to the Gaza campaign?

choices.text: They suggest that adults should decide everything without hearing children.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五與第六段都強調聽取兒童對影響自身事項的意見。

choices.text: They imply that giving one speech fully satisfies all children’s needs.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第六段將傾聽連結決策，第四段也說一場活動不足以滿足所有需求。

choices.text: They prove that play has no connection with other childhood needs.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七段明確把遊戲、健康與教育等視為相互關聯的面向。

choices.text: They provide a framework for including children’s views and treating play as part of their rights.
choices.explanation: 正確。第六段說明表意與意見獲重視，第七段說明遊戲等權利，與活動回應兒童需求的做法相連。

quiz.explanation: 公約背景有助於理解兩個重點：兒童的意見應影響相關討論與決策；遊戲則屬於兒童權利的一部分。文章沒有把一次發言或一次活動視為全部工作已完成。

evidence.quote: It says those views should receive appropriate weight, considering the child's age and maturity.
Article 31 recognizes children's rights to rest, leisure, play, and cultural activities.
